verdicts.title: Key-file migration on Windows: a failed delete of the raw .bak fails the build after a successful migration and leaves the raw key, which createOnce later restores
verdicts.tried: Read KeySources.replaceWith/createOnce (current lines 244-353). The failing branch (old.delete() false after file->.bak and tmp->file renames) is reached only when tmp.renameTo(file) does not replace an existing target, which never happens on macOS/POSIX (rename replaces atomically), so the path cannot be driven here without contriving a directory as the key file. The second half (createOnce restoring a leftover .<name>.bak when the key file is missing) is visible in the code at lines 254-259, but the precondition needs a Windows file system; not provable or disprovable on this machine.

verdicts.title: Custom-authenticator login for another user skips that user's pre-hash IP/user-only waits
verdicts.drop_reason: Not a defect against intent: SEC-FLOW-012 (docs/spec/19 L1381-1394) keys the IP, (user,IP) and user-only limits on the typed login name before findByUsername, and IR-TOKEN-001 leaves what a custom Authenticator answers to the app (app-defined identifier mapping). The resolved user's own Lockout is still consulted (PasswordLogin.finish: lock.isLocked(id) on the found user's id, lines ~320). No AC requires the pre-hash limits to be re-keyed on the authenticator's answer.

verdicts.title: Unused 4-argument TokenPair constructor yields empty userId/familyId
verdicts.drop_reason: Style/dead-code only: the 4-argument TokenPair constructor has no caller (only TokenService.java:124 uses the 6-argument form); no reachable behaviour.

verdicts.title: Audit log line is not unambiguously parseable
verdicts.drop_reason: Format/style only: no AC of FR-AUTH-009 (docs/spec/17 L1999-2012) or docs/api/auth.md L1022 ('이벤트마다 INFO 한 줄') requires a machine-parseable key=value line; C0/DEL are escaped so no forged log line through the Logger. U+2028/U+0085 handling is a viewer concern.

verdicts.title: AccessTokens trusts the codec for expiry although it re-checks the type
verdicts.drop_reason: Intended by IR-TOKEN-002 AC-2 (docs/spec/18 L1285) and docs/api/auth.md L1248: a protected request is authenticated from the claims the configured codec's decode returns, and the codec owns validation (the default HS256 codec checks exp). 0.11.0 ships no other codec; a custom codec that skips expiry is an app codec bug, not a framework defect.

verdicts.title: ApiKeyUsage.lastWrite is only cleared by auth.apiKeys().revoke
verdicts.drop_reason: No intent contradicted: PERF-APIKEY-001 (docs/spec/21 L2103-2114) only fixes once-per-minute, off-path, best-effort updates. The map holds one Long per key id ever used in the process (bounded by distinct keys), an accepted memory/maintainability trade-off with no AC requiring eviction on every delete path.

verdicts.title: AtomicFiles.load reads a whole store file into memory with no size bound
verdicts.drop_reason: already resolved: AtomicFiles.load(File,long,TooLarge,...) now compares the file length with the store limit before reading (AtomicFiles.java:164-207, buffer sized from length), and the user, refresh, throttle and device-trust stores use it (executed: a 900 MB users.json -> IOException 'FAIL: ... above the limit of 8388608 bytes'). The remaining FileGroupStore case is the same defect, kept separately as R2-M1-F04.

verdicts.title: PrincipalCache walks every entry on each miss once 10,000 live entries exist
